MARLBOROUGH STREET POLICE COURT // SUMMARY COMMITTAL FOR JEWEL LARCENY & PERJURY.
1. Person James Ryder [ID:P541] is named as Prime Accused and head attendant of Hotel Cosmopolitan.
2. Person James Ryder [ID:P541] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-RYDER-HOTEL].
3. Charges framed under Larceny Act (Theft of Countess of Morcar's Blue Carbuncle Gemstone) and Section 193 IPC equivalent (False Evidence).
4. Person Catherine Cusack [ID:P542] is named as Co-Accused and Countess's confidential maid.
5. Person Catherine Cusack [ID:P542] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-CUSACK-MAID].
6. Person John Horner [ID:P543] is referenced as innocent plumber falsely framed by Ryder.
7. Person John Horner [ID:P543] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-HORNER-PLUMBING].
8. Person Henry Baker [ID:P544] is referenced in this case as an innocent witness.
9. Evidence proves Accused P541 wired $120,000 in gem fencing kickbacks into Account 010 / ACC-CUSACK-MAID after secreting the gem inside market livestock.
